positions.as_written: Assess the tendon at its femoral attachment on coronal and axial images.
Follow it through the hiatus to the musculotendinous junction.
Assess the muscle belly for injury, which is a different problem from the tendon.
Assess the popliteomeniscal fascicles, which attach it to the lateral meniscus.
